coverage: Partial assertions only; permanent manual checklist remains unchecked.

settings-appearance.assertions: Appearance opens its expected content; toolbar Back returns to Settings and Chats.

settings-notifications.assertions: Notifications opens its expected content; toolbar Back returns to Settings and Chats.

settings-read-aloud.assertions: Read Aloud opens its expected content; toolbar Back returns to Settings and Chats.

settings-data.assertions: Data Usage opens its expected content; toolbar Back returns to Settings and Chats.

settings-privacy.assertions: Privacy & Security opens its expected content; toolbar Back returns to Settings and Chats.

settings-connectors.assertions: AI Agents opens its expected content; toolbar Back returns to Settings and Chats.

settings-help.assertions: Help opens its expected content; toolbar Back returns to Settings and Chats.

navigation-settings-back.assertions: Settings opens through the accessible avatar and System Back restores Chats.

navigation-selector-cancel.assertions: Profile selector dismissal preserves active Alice.

navigation-account-empty.assertions: Carol has no Alice conversation; returning to Alice restores her group.

navigation-search-clear.assertions: Title search finds the generated group, excludes it for a unique query, and Back clears search.

navigation-help-about.assertions: About shows app/version information and System Back returns to Help; no external browser is opened.

conversation-history-back.assertions: Generated native history renders in the conversation and Back restores the chat list.

conversation-draft-return.assertions: An unsent composer draft appears in the list and survives leaving and reopening its conversation.

conversation-send.assertions: UI send clears the composer, renders the outgoing text, updates the list, and reaches Bob exactly once in native history.

conversation-selection-cancel.assertions: Long-press message actions can be dismissed without removing the selected message.

conversation-landscape.assertions: Conversation history stays accessible across landscape and portrait rotation.

settings-profile-keys.assertions: Private key remains concealed when opening and leaving Profile Keys; no reveal or clipboard export.

navigation-profile-edit-cancel.assertions: Back discards an edited profile name without publishing it.

preferences-dark.assertions: Dark selection survives leaving/reopening Appearance; fixture verifies the selected theme.

preferences-font-large.assertions: Large font selection remains displayed after returning to Appearance; fixture verifies the selected font scale.

preferences-font-cancel.assertions: System Back dismisses the font-size picker and retains the default choice.

preferences-language-cancel.assertions: Language picker is reachable and Back returns to Appearance without a language change.

conversation-emoji-cancel.assertions: Emoji picker opens and dismisses without sending or removing history.

conversation-attachment-cancel.assertions: Attachment menu opens and dismisses without starting a media send.

advanced-dictation.assertions: Dictation opens its own content and System Back returns to Settings.

advanced-gestures.assertions: Swipe actions opens its own content and System Back returns to Settings.

advanced-folders.assertions: Folders opens its own content and System Back returns to Settings.

advanced-relays.assertions: Relays opens its own content and System Back returns to Settings.

advanced-folder-create-cancel.assertions: Back cancels an entered folder name and no new folder appears.

advanced-custom-emoji.assertions: Custom emoji management opens with photo/file actions and Back returns to Appearance.

connectors-hermes.assertions: hermes setup sheet displays its prompt and copy action; Back dismisses without installing, copying or opening a browser.

connectors-openclaw.assertions: openclaw setup sheet displays its prompt and copy action; Back dismisses without installing, copying or opening a browser.

connectors-opencode.assertions: opencode setup sheet displays its prompt and copy action; Back dismisses without installing, copying or opening a browser.

connectors-codex.assertions: codex setup sheet displays its prompt and copy action; Back dismisses without installing, copying or opening a browser.

connectors-claude.assertions: claude setup sheet displays its prompt and copy action; Back dismisses without installing, copying or opening a browser.

groups-details-return.assertions: Conversation header opens real group details and Back restores its history.

groups-members.assertions: Native group roster displays both generated members.

groups-relays.assertions: Group relay details can be opened and dismissed without editing or publishing relay configuration.

creation-message-back.assertions: New Message opens its recipient screen and Back restores the chat list.

creation-search-invalid.assertions: Malformed recipient input stays in the picker; no conversation is opened automatically.

creation-group-back.assertions: Group recipient picker Back restores New Message.

creation-group-setup-cancel.assertions: An entered group name can be canceled before native submission.

creation-group-name-retained.assertions: Unsubmitted setup name survives Back to the recipient picker and return.

actions-edit-cancel.assertions: Editing an outgoing fixture message can be canceled with its original text retained.

actions-forward-cancel.assertions: Forward destination picker opens then cancels without sending.

actions-selection-back.assertions: Explicit Select mode can be dismissed while keeping the transcript.

actions-info-back.assertions: Message information opens and Back restores its source transcript.

groups-mute-cancel.assertions: Mute duration dialog cancels without activating a mute.

groups-retention-cancel.assertions: Disappearing-message picker opens and cancels before a native mutation.

groups-edit-cancel.assertions: Admin group editor opens and cancels with the existing group title retained.

groups-notifications-back.assertions: Conversation notification settings opens through group details and Back restores that group.

polls-cancel.assertions: Cancel a typed poll draft without publishing it.

polls-question-required.assertions: Empty question submission stays in the dialog with its inline validation error.

polls-two-options-required.assertions: One nonempty option is rejected without closing the draft.

polls-duplicate-options.assertions: Case-equivalent options show the duplicate validation error.

polls-question-boundary.assertions: A 1025-byte question is rejected at the 1024-byte limit.

polls-option-boundary.assertions: A 257-byte option is rejected at the 256-byte limit.

polls-add-remove-option.assertions: Add and remove a third option while retaining the two required option fields.

polls-custom-zero.assertions: Custom zero duration is rejected inline instead of starting a deadline.

folders-create-reopen.assertions: Save a named folder, reopen its editor and retain the saved name.

folders-empty-name.assertions: Empty name keeps Save disabled and Back leaves without a discard prompt.

folders-whitespace-name.assertions: Whitespace name keeps Save disabled; explicit discard leaves no custom folder.

folders-keep-editing.assertions: Keep Editing preserves an unsaved name; subsequent explicit discard removes the draft.

folders-delete-cancel.assertions: Cancel the folder-specific delete confirmation and retain the saved folder.

folders-delete-confirm.assertions: Confirm deletion of the generated custom folder; fixture checks it was removed.

preferences-light.assertions: Light theme survives leaving and reopening Appearance; fixture checks the state projection.

preferences-amoled.assertions: AMOLED theme survives leaving and reopening Appearance; fixture checks the state projection.

nested-action-color.assertions: Action-color controls and preview open, then Back returns to Appearance without committing a draft.

nested-bubble-colors.assertions: Bubble-color editor opens its sent-message controls and preview, then Back returns to Appearance.

nested-blocked-empty.assertions: Fresh native account shows the explicit empty block list; Back returns to Privacy.

nested-diagnostics.assertions: Sharing choices open and dismiss without granting usage or diagnostic sharing.

nested-default-retention.assertions: Default retention picker opens and cancels without changing new-chat policy.

nested-bug-report.assertions: Bug-report destination and opening action are visible; Back returns to Help without opening GitHub.

nested-share-connect.assertions: Active-profile header opens its public QR card and Back restores Settings without sharing.

nested-donate.assertions: Donate opens its action and returns without launching a browser or payment flow.

reader-back.assertions: Expanded Markdown reader opens its generated heading and returns to the source conversation.

reader-scroll-end.assertions: Reader scroll reaches the actual end of a long native message before returning.

reader-rotation.assertions: Expanded reader remains open through landscape and portrait configuration changes.

reader-actions-cancel.assertions: Reader action menu cancels back to the same expanded message without copying.

reader-reply-cancel.assertions: Reply from the expanded message creates a reply target; cancel removes that target without sending.

reader-links-library.assertions: A genuine native text link exposes the shared Links destination; Back restores its group without browser navigation.

composer-expand-collapse.assertions: Expand and collapse the composer without dropping an unsent native draft.

composer-expanded-rotation.assertions: Expanded draft text survives landscape and portrait rotation.

composer-expanded-keyboard-back.assertions: Keyboard Back preserves the expanded draft and its collapse control.

composer-expanded-route-return.assertions: Expanded-to-compact draft survives leaving and reopening the conversation.

developer-unlock.assertions: Seven version taps reveal Developer Tools with its development warning; Back returns to About.

developer-mode-off.assertions: Turning developer mode off hides debugging controls while leaving Key Packages available.

developer-key-packages.assertions: Key Packages opens its real native-backed content and Back restores Developer Tools; no package is published.

developer-quarantine.assertions: Quarantined Groups opens its real content and Back restores Developer Tools; no recovery mutation is submitted.

developer-diagnostics.assertions: Diagnostics opens Events and actions and Back restores Developer Tools.

developer-diagnostics-actions.assertions: Opening and dismissing Diagnostics actions retains Events without clearing or submitting native work.

developer-diagnostics-health.assertions: Health shows its controls; cancelling returns to Events without sending a diagnostic message.

support-entry-back.assertions: Support contact information is displayed; Back returns to Settings without contacting Support.

support-relay-guidance.assertions: The loopback-only profile needs public receiving relays; Support offers relay guidance and cannot start a support chat.

support-relays-back.assertions: Support receiving-relay guidance opens Relays and Back returns to Support without publishing or starting a chat.
